title: pyrus malus var. pumila
intro: Pyrus malus var. pumila, commonly known as dwarf or shrub apple, is a deciduous shrub or small tree belonging to the rose family (Rosaceae). This plant is rich in health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as soothing digestive issues, reducing fever, and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Pyrus malus var. pumila include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. Additionally, the plant's extracts have been found to exhibit antidiabetic, antihypertensive, and anti-cancer activities, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
